headline: Readiness composite is still red (37.4, sleep-driven) on a day the calendar has stacked a 13km long run AND a Un1t class — pick your effort carefully.
body_state: The deterministic verdict is red: HRV 37ms sits below your personal band, and 14-day sleep debt is still building (last night 6.1h/72 sleep score — one decent night doesn't clear a two-week hole). Body battery recovered +37 overnight but only to 38, under the 40 floor where quality work underperforms. Garmin's own training_readiness reads a milder 46 ("Productive"), but the composite's overtraining flag is "caution" — trust the composite. Skin temp is flat (0.0°C) so this isn't illness, it's accumulated load plus poor sleep.
session: Plan calls for a 13.4km unstructured easy long run (4:50-5:19/km, "run to feel, switch off") — right call for today's readiness. But the calendar also has a 45min Un1t class booked the same day, and that exact stack (long run + Un1t same day) is what the last two week-reviews flagged as the pattern behind last week's readiness crash. Yesterday's "easy" 7km also finished at HR166/RPE6 — nearly double the prescribed effort, a fast negative split late. Today: cap the long run by HR/pace, not feel, and if Un1t goes ahead keep it genuine zone 2 — or defer one of the two.
recent: A repeating pattern across the last three sessions: efforts are landing off-target in ways that trace to fatigue, not motivation. Aug 14's easy run sped up late (159→161 cadence but stride length carried the pace, HR closing at 162-166). Aug 12's tempo undershot both distance (2.98 of 4km) and pace (4:38 vs 4:18-4:32/km target), with HR never reaching threshold (143 vs 163) despite RPE8 — the body pulling the plug before the mind agreed. Aug 13's Un1t stayed appropriately light (zone 2-3, low body battery respected). Grey-zone training is now a ranked limiter: only 19.7% of running time is truly easy against an 80% target.
focus: Cap today's long run by pace/HR (4:50-5:19/km, stay under ~zone 2) — yesterday's fast finish is the failure mode to avoid repeating
Don't stack both sessions hard: if Un1t runs today, keep it genuine zone 2 recovery, not a second stimulus
Cadence is still 154-161 spm vs the 168-172 target, and the fix (shorten stride, don't lengthen it for pace) is exactly what protects the easy-pace ceiling too
